description: Unexpected port congestion caused 3-week dwell time for inbound container
root_cause: Understaffing at port due to labor disputes
lessons_learned: Need real-time port visibility; consider port insurance
assumptions_wrong: Assumed port operates at normal capacity; actual: 30% reduction in throughput

incident_name: Supplier quality issue - electronics batch recall
description: Defective component batch from Bangladesh supplier affected 2,500 units
root_cause: Quality control gap in supplier's new line
lessons_learned: Tighten supplier quality audits; require redundant testing
assumptions_wrong: Assumed supplier's quality certifications meant zero defects; actual: needed tighter audits

description: Major carrier cut capacity, doubled rates for Asia-Europe lanes
lessons_learned: Diversify carriers; negotiate long-term rate protection
assumptions_wrong: Assumed carrier capacity stable; actual: highly volatile during peak season

description: Port congestion from labour disputes caused 3-week container dwell times
